scope: Temporary proof of proposed fixes; not an implementation of the assessment frontend

production_checks.name: Debounced URL-driven loading without duplicate API fetch
Back cancels pending search and Forward restores filters
Older navigation cannot erase newer draft
Late older navigation cannot replace latest results
A-B-A cancellation and leaf render isolation
Filter change aborts and clears active stream
Network failure produces error UI and clears loading

development_checks.name: Development mount has no duplicate event API request or hydration error
Development replay supports A-B-A cancellation and leaf-only updates
HTTP 500 shows error without rendering error body as a summary or leaving loading active

notes: Initial event loading and filter navigation use a shared server loader with the original 150-550ms jitter; no competing client API fetch.
Older-navigation tests separately cover completion before a newer debounce fires and completion after newer results arrive.
Back/Forward assertions verify URL, input, severity and event counts; Back cancels a pending draft timer.
Summary owns text/loading/error state; request generations and AbortControllers prevent stale updates.
The 12ms payload formatting workload remains and is isolated from token updates.
Temporary commit counters run after commit and do not affect rendered markup.
This prototype validates architecture and races; the actual frontend still needs implementation and acceptance verification.
